I saved Ilse's note as a fact in the shared brain: Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November 2026. I also replied to them in the #north-team thread to confirm it's recorded.

I took the year to be 2026, since they posted on 14 October 2026. There was no record of this account before, so nothing was overwritten, and no account page exists to attach it to. A renewal date counts as account information rather than a money figure, so posting it in the team channel needed no approval.
